value: At Darion's runeforge, the hammer is laid with Primordial Saronite and the acidic blood of the plague abominations Rotface and Festergut. Fire takes the components into itself. From sacred memory and corruption bound together, Darion shapes Shadow's Edge, an axe with power not yet its own. He places it in the seeker's hands and leaves the next work to the one who must carry it.
editorNote: Research status: the cited quest/item mirrors support this original paraphrase, but original Wrath client/build capture and human lore review remain required. Do not infer a canonical player, exact cross-story date, exact return-NPC placement, or later Arthas outcome.
